mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (message_id, conversation_id, request_id, client_message_id, role, content, content_type, sequence_no, status, error_code, error_message, metadata) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{conversationId}, #{requestId}, #{clientMessageId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{contentType}, #{sequenceNo}, #{status}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{metadata})
mapper.select: SELECT message_id, conversation_id, request_id, client_message_id, role, content, content_type, sequence_no, status, error_code, error_message, metadata, created_at, updated_at FROM chat_message WHERE message_id = #{messageId}
